messages:
maria: Dropped a couple of nsys timelines from yesterday's prefetch + adaptive-batching experiment. Noticed cache hit % dropped from ~62% to ~18% when batch-size-adaptive toggled. Upload: https://perf.rw/trace/1778451200

josh: Hmm that's pretty big. Which exact config comparisons? adaptive_bsize=true vs false?

maria: adaptive_bsize=true. Root cause looks like prefetch injects extra KV read kernels that evict hot prefix entries. Timeline snippet: 
```
[nsys timeline snippet]
2025-12-01T14:03:21 kernel: kv_cache_lookup  duration=1.2ms
2025-12-01T14:03:21 kernel: prefetch_kv    duration=0.9ms
2025-12-01T14:03:21 kernel: self_attention_fwd duration=2.8ms
```
Cache stats from runtime log: 
```
KV_CACHE_HIT: 18
KV_CACHE_MISS: 82
prefix_reuse_window_ms: 12
```

tracebot: Trace uploaded: https://perfetto.link/trace/abc123 (nsys -> perfetto conversion completed)

aisha: Did you compare sequence length distributions? If adaptive batching increased seq variance, prefix reuse will drop.

maria: Yes — avg seq len unchanged (~256) but tail got spikier; lots of short prompts interleaved with long ones which breaks reuse.

devon: I ran a microbench with deterministic arrivals and reproduced pretty reliably. With prefetch enabled we see `kv_lookup` kernels spike at batch boundaries; flame graph shows repeated kv rows.

josh: Possible mitigations:
- change prefetch scheduling to avoid prefetching on batches with mixed lengths
- increase prefix retention TTL from 12ms -> 50ms
- enable LRU pinning for hot prefixes (pin top-k)

maria: I tried TTL=50ms locally: hit rate jumped to 54% and p95 latency dropped ~12%. Memory footprint up ~8%.

aisha: Also consider length-aware coalescing: group similar seq lengths before batching so prefixes line up.

devon: Agreed. Kernel selection note: quant_matmul variant is getting chosen for some batch shapes; timeline shows a fallback to a slower matmul kernel when prefetch threads saturate SMs (contention). So both scheduling and kernel selection interact.

maria: I'll open a PR with a conservative TTL bump + a flag to disable prefetch on mixed-length batches. PR will include the nsys timeline, perf numbers, and a short reproducer.

josh: thanks — paste the microbench numbers here when ready. Quick metrics we want: p50/p95 latency, tok/sec, kv hit %, and memory delta.

maria: For reference, local microbench (nsys -> parsed):
```
baseline: adaptive_bsize=false, TTL=12ms -> KV_HIT=61.7, p95=43ms
experiment: adaptive_bsize=true, TTL=12ms -> KV_HIT=17.9, p95=78ms
experiment+TTL=50ms -> KV_HIT=54.2, p95=68ms, memory +8%
```

tracebot: Added label `prefetch-mixedbatch` to traces and attached to the ticket RW-3482.

devon: Cool. Once PR lands, let's run the standard perf suite on Dedicated (A100) and on the q4_* quantized model to validate kernel selection and mem behavior.

maria: Will schedule the runs and post results here. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
